summary: P2 Play With Coach Steps 3-5 testing complete. Backend (16/16 passed): Behavior extraction, CPR computation, Identity engine all working. Frontend (13/13 passed): CPR score/interpretation and Identity label/description displayed correctly on game end.
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - tests create and clean up their own sessions
context_for_next_testing_agent: Steps 3-5 fully tested. Key features: (1) Behavior extraction stores events in session.behavior_events with types like impulse_move, threat_ignored, rapid_streak. (2) CPR computed on session end with overall_cpr (0-100), interpretation text, recommendations list, and component breakdown (decision_quality, time_management, threat_awareness, emotional_control, focus_consistency). (3) Identity updated on session end with identity_label (The Calculator, The Warrior, etc.), identity_description, trait_snapshot (aggression, calculation, consistency, resilience, risk_tolerance), confidence (0-1), and sessions_analyzed count. API endpoints: GET /api/coach/play/identity, GET /api/coach/play/cpr/history, GET /api/coach/play/behaviors/{session_id}. Frontend displays CPR score badge with interpretation and recommendations plus identity label with description and session count.

backend: POST /api/coach/play/end - Computes CPR and updates identity
GET /api/coach/play/cpr/history - Returns CPR history with average
CPR components: decision_quality, time_management, threat_awareness, emotional_control, focus_consistency
Identity traits: aggression, calculation, consistency, resilience, risk_tolerance
Identity confidence increases with more sessions (confidence = sessions/10)
frontend: CPR score badge displayed on game end (0-100 scale)
Player identity label displayed (The Calculator, The Warrior, etc.)
Guardian status indicator with interventions remaining
